Privacy Policy

How we process personal data. Last updated: June 2026.

1. Controller

Hasi Elektronic — Owner: Hamdi Güncavdı
Street + No. · 71665 Vaihingen an der Enz · Germany
Email: h.guencavdi@hasi-elektronic.de

2. Two roles: Praxmate as provider and as processor

As provider: When you register on praxmate.de or visit our marketing pages, we are the controller of your data.

As processor: When you book an appointment as a patient through a clinic, that clinic is the controller. We process your data on its behalf and enter into a data processing agreement (DPA) under Art. 28 GDPR with every clinic.

3. Collection and processing of personal data

3.1 When visiting our website

Technical data (IP, user agent, timestamp, URL) is processed when praxmate.de is accessed. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. No profiling.

3.2 During clinic registration

The following data (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR — performance of a contract):

  • Clinic name, URL slug, city, phone number, specialization
  • Owner: name, email, password (hashed, PBKDF2 100,000 iterations)
  • Language preference (de / en / tr)
  • When paying: Stripe processes the card data — we never see the card number.

3.3 During patient booking

When a patient books with a clinic hosted by us:

  • First and last name, email, phone
  • Appointment details (practitioner, treatment type, date / time, notes)
  • Insurance status (statutory / private / self-pay)
  • Unique magic_token for password-less cancellation

4. Recipients / Processors

ServicePurposeLocation
CloudflareHosting (Pages, Workers, D1, R2, KV)EU region (Frankfurt + Dublin)
StripePayment processingIreland (EU)
ResendTransactional emailsEU region (eu-west-1, Ireland)

DPAs are in place with all processors pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. Any transfer to third countries (USA) via Stripe / Cloudflare is based on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs); the data processing itself takes place in the EU.

5. Storage period

  • Account data: until end of contract + 6 months
  • Appointment data: until deletion request by the clinic (max. 10 years pursuant to § 630f BGB)
  • Booking token (magic_token): 12 months after the appointment
  • Web server logs: 14 days

6. Cookies

Only technically necessary cookies (session, language). No tracking or advertising cookies. No consent required under § 25 (2) TTDSG.

7. Your rights

  • Access (Art. 15)
  • Rectification (Art. 16)
  • Erasure (Art. 17) — patient self-service is available in the confirmation email
  • Restriction (Art. 18)
  • Data portability (Art. 20) — a GDPR export endpoint is provided
  • Objection (Art. 21)
  • Complaint (Art. 77) — State Commissioner for Data Protection Baden-Württemberg, baden-wuerttemberg.datenschutz.de

Requests: h.guencavdi@hasi-elektronic.de — response within 30 days.

8. Security

  • TLS (HTTPS) for all connections
  • Passwords: PBKDF2 100,000 iterations + salt
  • Rate limit: 5 login attempts / 15 min / email
  • Optional 2FA (TOTP) for clinic owners
  • Daily encrypted R2 backup (30-day retention)

9. Changes

The current version is always available at this URL.
